name: StageObby
brief: A short obby: a start floor with the SpawnLocation, then 6 floating platforms to jump across one after another, then a finish pad.
contract: Create a SpawnLocation (on the start floor) inside script.Parent.
Name the 6 platforms Stage1, Stage2, ... Stage6 in the order the player jumps them.
The finish pad is a Part named Goal after Stage6.
Every platform must be reachable with a normal jump from the one before it.
